Metadata.title: YiLink
Metadata.description: An open-source link-in-bio for Chinese creators

Marketing.tagline: One link for everything you make.
Marketing.description: An open-source link-in-bio for Chinese creators that puts your work, social profiles, and contact details on one WeChat-friendly page.

hero.eyebrow: Open source · WeChat friendly · Your data
hero.caption: The free plan stays free, starts with 3 pages, and takes no commission.
hero.previewTitle: Live preview of the YiLink illustrator demo page
hero.previewCaption: This is the running public page, not a product screenshot.

features.title: Less setup. More sharing for real.
features.description: No vague creator promises. Every feature maps to a real job: building, sharing inside WeChat, and keeping control of your data.

template.title: A useful page in five minutes
template.description: Start from 8 practical scenes for photographers, illustrators, developers, and more. Every block remains editable.

wechat.title: Opens in WeChat, ships as a QR poster
wechat.description: Public pages account for the WeChat browser, while links, QR codes, and themed posters live in one sharing panel.

openSource.title: Open source, self-hostable, data in your hands
openSource.description: Apache-2.0 licensed with SQLite by default. Use the hosted edition or keep both code and data on your own server.

pricing.title: Pay once. Keep using it.
pricing.description: You buy defined software capabilities and page quotas—not a vague promise of unlimited infrastructure forever.
pricing.promise: One payment, lifetime use, no price increases; existing customers always keep their price
pricing.fairUse: See the documentation for quotas and reasonable-use limits: they prevent abuse, not genuine use.

free.name: Free
free.description: Build, publish, and use the core distribution tools before you decide to pay.

mini.name: Lifetime Basic
mini.description: For individual creators with several roles, projects, or campaign pages.

pro.name: Lifetime Complete
pro.description: A clear 50-page ceiling for teams, studios, and long-running operations.

pricing.trustTitle: YiLink will not lock you in.
pricing.trustDescription: Each scar left by the category should become a product principle users can verify.

commitments.export: Export your data at any time in an open format—a lesson from Bento shutting down and Milkshake offering no export.
commitments.free: The free plan stays available, takes no commission, and lets you turn off branding—a lesson from Linktree's 12% fee.
commitments.price: Existing customers always keep their price—a lesson from Linktree's 67% increase.
commitments.moderation: We hide first and provide human appeal; we never publicly shame a page with an “ACCOUNT BANNED” label.
commitments.openSource: Open source is the final promise: if the hosted service disappears, you can self-host and take everything with you.

footer.label: Footer navigation
footer.description: An open-source link-in-bio and digital card for Chinese creators.

Login.title: Log in to YiLink
Login.invalidFields: Enter a valid email and a password of at least 8 characters.
Login.registered: Registration complete. You can now log in.

Register.title: Create an account
Register.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters; letters, numbers, and symbols are recommended.
Register.shortPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters.

Studio.title: My page
Studio.description: Start with a scene template, then shape every detail into your own page.
Studio.emptyDescription: Choose a template for your use case, then customize the content, theme, and publishing settings.
Studio.chooseTemplateHint: Templates provide a theme, layout, and useful starter copy. Everything stays editable.
Studio.slugHint: Use 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens; start and end with a letter or number.
Studio.ctaDescription: Set one primary action at the bottom of the page for contact or a destination link.
Studio.ctaUniqueHint: One-conversion rule: when the WeChat CTA is on, WeChat blocks are hidden in preview and on the public page.
Studio.reviewPending: Content is under review and will reappear after approval.
Studio.pageSettingsHint: Identity details update in the preview instantly.

guardrails.ADJACENT_FULL: Consecutive large cards can feel crowded; mix in a smaller card for breathing room
guardrails.NO_FOCUS: The first screen has no focal card, so visitors may not know where to look first
guardrails.BOTTOM_HOLE: There is an empty space at the bottom; Tidy can close it
guardrails.blocking: The {type} card is cropped too tightly to use. Enlarge it before publishing

canvas.title: Free-layout canvas
canvas.hint: Drag cards or handles on desktop. Arrow keys move; Shift + arrows resize.

conversion.title: Convert to free layout
conversion.description: Compare the current page with the converted arrangement. This preview is generated locally and is not saved until you apply it.
conversion.safe: Switch back to list or grid at any time. Your content and saved placements remain intact.
conversion.failed: Conversion failed. Check the page content and try again.

blocks.title: Content blocks
blocks.empty: No content blocks yet. Add one from the menu above.
blocks.dividerHint: Dividers have no additional settings and use the current theme's hairline style.

defaults.text: Write a short, concrete introduction about yourself.

Studio.dataDescription: See views, unique visitors, and clicks for each page over the last 30 days.
